data: In fiscal 2025 (the year ended December 31, 2025), Tesla reported total revenues of $94,827 million and total cost of revenues of $77,733 million, for a gross profit of $17,094 million and a gross margin of about 18.0%. After operating expenses of $12,739 million, which comprised research and development of $6,411 million, selling, general and administrative of $5,834 million, and restructuring and other of $494 million, income from operations was $4,355 million, an operating margin of about 4.6%. For comparison, fiscal 2024 revenues were $97,690 million, gross profit was $17,450 million (a gross margin of about 17.9%), and operating income was $7,076 million (an operating margin of about 7.2%). The gross margin therefore held roughly flat in 2025, while the operating margin fell by about 2.6 percentage points, mainly because operating expenses rose by about 23%.
